I so wanted to love this product because it was the first all-natural deodorant that really worked scent-wise but I had a very strong reaction to it and I'm not particularly sensitive or allergic. When I contacted Customer Service about this, I was told that they added more baking soda so that the product would not liquify during shipping!!! My response was..."who cares!". I also loved the glass jar it came in compared to plastic packaging. I love the Patchouli scent and when I received it I was very pleased as to the small amount that is needed. I detoxed off the aluminum filled deodorants for 2 weeks, (after using deodorants for over 30 years) then I started using PRIMAL PIT PASTE.  I ordered the PATCHOULI and I didn't like the scent of it very much, so I microwaved the pit paste for about 20 seconds then stirred in a very small amount of patchouli-rose essential oil, put the pit paste in the fridge to harden it back up and I LOVE IT. I haven't gotten any rashes and wonder if it was my 2 week detox off of the other stuff that helped wi

I started using this product at the end of March. Worked great, smelled great. After using it for almost 3 months I noticed that my skin (underarm) was getting darker. Then I developed a rash. My wife was using the same brand but a different jar (scent) and the same thing happened to her. In going back to other peoples reviews it seems to happen a lot. This product went from 5 stars to nothing.

I've tried sooo many "healthy" deodorants. This one takes the cake. Goes on smooth, smells good, keeps the funk at bay. Goes on easily and absorbs dry. Only needs one application per day. I have sensitive skin but this has not caused me any irritation and, like I said, actually keeps the pits smelling like a fresh hippy (I got the patchouli). Winner.

I did not like the scent at all. I do love patrouli in general and use alot of patrouli scented products and essential oils. The scent at first was pleasant but after "activation" it turned terrible..wish I could return it for another lavender scented one. The lavender is by far a much more pleasant smell.

My wife and I really liked primal paste products at first. But Then we noticed these large bumps that started to get larger to the point that they became huge and extremely painful. It happened to both of us. I was using the stick kind, my wife was using the jar.
I love the natural theory behind this, but it totally broke me out and discolored my skin due to an unhealthy amount of baking soda being absorbed into my skin. I had to return it :(.
It doesn't smell the best. Had someone say I smell like bug spray. Won't be buying again!
The best natural deodorant I have used. I suggest trying it.

I'm so glad I found PPP! I have tried so many natural deodorants and had no luck. This really works! Here's what I wish I knew before. After a lifetime of using antiperspirant, my underarms needed to detox. I thought I was allergic to PPP at first when I developed raw, red armpits. But after thinking about it and reading up, I realized that I needed to let it happen. The detox took a long time, longer than I expected, but I'm so glad I stuck with it. reviews.t: Excellent product! Don't worry about the small jar either
reviews.x: Shocked!  A natural deodorant that actually works.  I've tried a ton of different products and am elated to say that you can actually apply this in the morning and not be worried about "when" your deodorant will wear off.  Excellent product!  Don't worry about the small jar either, you only need one pea size ball per arm per day.  The only downfall is the application, you basically have to smear this around your armpit every morning with your finger.  It does wash off of your finger easi

I tried this product for several months after a friend recommended it. While it works moderately well for odor, it left residue on my clothes that have been difficult to impossible to wash out of them. Consequently, it has ruined some of my shirts. Fortunately, I found Green Tidings, and it works much better for odor and doesn't leave residue on my clothes. I think it is just a matter of finding the right natural product that works best for each individual.

reviews.t: It works but does cause a rash if used continually
reviews.x: I love this stuff but it does cause a rash if used continually or right after shaving.  Rash is painful but goes away after a day.  I still continue to use this stuff as my main deodorant...I take a break from wearing it for a day or two every once in a while though so I don't get the rash.  Wish they could fix the rash issue as the Patchouli is a very light smell that I love!  I am typically not a patchouli person either but I love the way this smells.

reviews.t: Patchouli scent was not a good match for me
reviews.x: I've been trying to make the switch to natural deodorants and experimenting with different products to find what works best for me. I bought Pit Paste on the recommendation of a friend and I like how it goes on, but for me the patchouli scent mixes with my natural scent in a really unpleasant way so I can't keep using it. I actually smell better when I don't use anything. Maybe I just need to try a different scent of Pit Paste?

reviews.t: Best pit paste deodorant on the market
reviews.x: Best pit paste deodorant on the market. I've been wearing it for almost a year and never have underarm odor. It's amazing. If you don't want to sweat, though, reconsider your purchase. This is a deodorant and not an antiperspirant. One still will sweat when wearing this pit paste. I LOVE the smell of patchouli.

reviews.t: I got a rash after 2 weeks of use but ...
reviews.x: I got a rash after 2 weeks of use but kept using for months and dealt with the rash for aluminum free sake.... until I found Bali deodorant which is also aluminum-free and didn't give me a rash.

reviews.t: My husband and I have both broken out in rashes ...
reviews.x: My husband and I have both broken out in rashes, they must have changed formula or something because we never had this issue with this brand before.

reviews.t: It used to contain beeswax which was what made this product unique and awesome.
reviews.x: It used to contain beeswax which was what made this product unique and awesome. Now, it's just disappointing :(
Smooth and gentle on my sensitive skin. Smells like heaven to me.

I love this deodorant, I am obsessed! I have tried EVERYTHING NATURAL and this is the only thing that works for me. I've tried: Tom's, making my own deodorant, coconut oil, Lavalin, and lots of other natural brands at Spouts and Whole Foods... I have very smelly armpits and this seems to be the only thing that works for me. I can go with this for at least a whole day, sometimes two. The bumps do not bother me so that is not a huge concern. After using this product and feeling like it did not really keep me fresh through tough sweating I decided to add a probiotic capsule to the jar. I live in Miami and have used it through May, June and July in this humid heatwave and I DON"T STINK! It lasts through the whole day. claims.text: Many reviewers report skin irritation, rashes, burns, or discoloration from using the product.
Several reviewers experienced painful lumps or bumps after use.
A common positive theme is that the deodorant actually works and controls odor effectively.
Some reviewers dislike the scent, with complaints that it smells bad or changes after use.
A few reviewers mention the product leaves residue on clothing or that the formula changed and no longer lasts as long.
